name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels: the road category for an electric two- or three-wheeler that isn't an electrically assisted bicycle or a moped. One under 5 horsepower is also a motor-driven cycle. Defined by Montana Code Annotated §61-1-101(43).

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground; bicycles, mopeds, motorized scooters and motorized nonstandard vehicles are excluded
No limit on motor power or speed

One designed for highway use is a motor vehicle; one designed for off-road recreation is an off-highway vehicle unless it's modified to meet the highway equipment standards and registered for the road
Riders need a driver's license with a motorcycle endorsement; an electric three-wheeler with a fully enclosed cab, seat and seatbelts needs none
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet
Registered as a motorcycle, and the owner must carry liability insurance
